releaseNote.en:
1. NOTE: Since v2.0, we have replaced our signing key, see GitHub Release Page for details.
  2. Fix: some weird behaviours of statusbar color animations
  3. Fix: player theme color flashing to default when resuming from background
  4. Fix: top of player conditionally peaking behind navigation bar on Android 15 and later
  5. Improve: optimize for square-shaped screens
  6. Improve: enlarger playback buttons
  7. Remove: shard elements transition animations for albums and artist details
  8. New: support the true edge-to-edge display for Android 11 and later (optional, experimental)
  9. Development: upgrade Kotlin to 2.4.10, update dependencies
